title: Chapter 992
paragraphs: Chapter 992
Episode 246. Mithra Desert War (2)
'...Magic!?'
'Zito's dead, so it can't be related to the demon world. Could it be because of the device used by the demon Kinzelo?'
Grrr...
Magic was rapidly amplifying. At a level that even the celestial beings could not entirely ignore, Jin scrutinized Shimat's atmosphere.
He didn't show it, but since Shimat also glanced at the magic, it seemed it wasn’t what he wanted.
Shimat thought the same thing, looking at Jin. The two men blended their swords and naturally moved toward the magic. Both wanted to identify the magic.
While Jin and Shimat approached the magic emission point, the concentration of the enemy's brainwaves in the area continued to diminish.
That, like the shock wave, was being absorbed by the necromancy device that Lanke had left behind as he fled.
Although the enemy race was intensifying the reduced concentration of enemy brainwaves even without Shimat's command, they could not help but be shocked.
The enemy's brainwaves are one of the enemy race's prides. Even the two aerial fortresses were affected by Lanke's crude equipment, which spread the brainwaves directly.
[Growl!]
[Who has awakened us!]
Suddenly, a deep voice resonated across the battlefield. By then, Jin and Shimat had reached near the necromancy equipment and were able to identify the voices' owners.
'What's that, a ghost...?'
'A demon's soul!? Was that demon Lanke Halobich trying to practice necromancy!?'
Ghosts, or souls.
Those summoned near the necromancy device's magic circle had such vague forms, like Orgal before recovery.
It was the moment Lanke's necromancy succeeded. It was a way that neither Lanke nor anyone in Kinzelo had expected.

'I see. The demon tried necromancy but lacked the necessary power. He filled that deficiency with our enemy race's energy and Jin Runcandel's aura. I thought he only schemed to summon us and the Vamel Alliance, but it seems that Kinzelo has quite an intelligent brain...!'
Of course, Shimat was mistaken.
The success of the necromancy was purely Kinzelo's fortune. Though 'power' was indeed lacking for necromancy as Shimat thought, Lanke had no idea of the failure's cause.
Even the ancient necromancy Lanke used was not perfect. Only the error in that magic formed the current coincidence.
The mistake was that the necromancy device sucked in 'all kinds of power' present nearby. All the absorbed power went directly to the summoned demons.
"[I am Sribee, the Great Demon of Tekan Mountain! I'll ask again, who has awakened me? We shall fight for that honorable person!]"
“I woke you up.”
“Me.”
Jin and Shimat spoke simultaneously. The two clicked their tongues inwardly at each other's blatant lies.

[You lot never change, always filled with liars. I, Sribee, know the name of the noble person who pulled us from the abyss. It's Lanke Hallobiche. Pretending not to know our summoner and seeking him was merely following tradition.]

[Hey, Sribee, aren’t these the guys? Jin Runcandel, who Lanke Hallobiche begged us to kill, and the god of a race called the enemy tribe. They bear a striking resemblance to those cursed by Lanke Hallobiche.]
[Ah, then our task is to rip you to shreds and kill you!]
The Great Demon Sribee lunged at Shimat.
Although the speed was quite fierce, the grotesque body that was evident even in the soul state was not very threatening.
Shimat raised a light sword wind to block Sribee's approach. Red sword energy spread in a circle, covering Sribee.
However, Sribee passed through Shimat's sword wind as if it were an illusion. Shimat swung his sword again, trying to cut him in two, but once more Sribee did not take any hits.
Thump-! Soon Sribee slammed his fist into Shimat's face. Shimat purposely took the punch, noticing that Sribee was not being cut.
[Ouch! Why is it so hard!]
There was a dull impact sound, but the one in apparent pain was Sribee.
“It's strange. My sword energy doesn't cut it as if it's an illusion, yet when it attacks, it acts like a being with mass.”
Shimat once more allowed Sribee's repeated attack to touch him, precisely retaliating the moment it made contact.
But again, the result was the same. Shimat's sword went deep into Sribee's body and hit thin air, while Sribee grasped his own fist in pain.
Jin recalled the day he and Mary faced Ozdok in the Black Sea. Ozdok also had the ability to ignore physical attacks.
‘It's different from Ozdok. As Shimat just confirmed, Sribee doesn't show a weakness even when attacking, unlike Ozdok.’
A being that completely defies physical laws.
The summoned demons all possessed this characteristic.
[This guy is so strong! The one next to him seems to be on the same level. Lanke Hallobiche, have you no conscience? This is too much for us retired old demons!]
Then the other summoned demons rushed at Jin and Shimat.
Jin intentionally blocked them with his spiritual sword, but it just passed through the translucent bodies of the demons.
That meant the summoned demons were capable of one-sided attacks.
"[Jin Runcandel, I had thought highly of you, but you were even more remarkable...! Facing the abyss of the witch and still so fine? How is that possible?]"
Suddenly, Jin was reminded of something Zito had said in the past.

'Sribee mentioned that he was summoned from the abyss. Being an existence from the witch's domain, he seems to have abilities that contradict the world's order. But there must be some constraints, whether it's confined space or, as now, having negligible combat power.'
The necromantic device continued to absorb the enemy brain waves.
Now it had changed into a form that could no longer be called a 'device.' The metals and various components that made up the device had completely melted and were mixing with the magic circle.
And even the magic circle had become semi-transparent like the demons. It had become impossible to undo or break the spell.
"Bakarun brethren, retrieve the enemy brain waves that have spread to my side."
It was a measure to prevent the demons from taking the enemy brain waves. With each absorption of the enemy brain waves, the demons' energy was growing a bit stronger.
Fzzz-!
On the other hand, Jin attracted the energy to himself instead.
"Interesting friends, don't you think? Shimat. I think it might be nice to involve these guys in our fight."
"Indeed, in your situation, having such variables might make it less burdensome to face me, Jin Runcandel."
[Grooah! Kill them!]
The demons roared as they sucked up that energy.
'Even if we retrieve the enemy brain waves, the demons are pulling energy from far away. Maybe they're absorbing the power of the entire desert.'
Such extensive energy absorption was impossible even with the technology of the Red Commandment race.
Shimat was feeling uncomfortable with this unexpected variable. He was enveloped in a feeling that somehow the demons would create significant trouble in this matter.
Swooosh-!
Jin's lightspeed thrust hit Shimat's chest. Shimat blocked the lightspeed thrust with Tetallon, and Pibeel simultaneously fired supporting bombardment.
When Jin split the bombardment in half, the pieces of the enemy brain matter that flew around were absorbed as souls by the demons.
Now Sribee didn't suffer as before when hitting Shimat. Although still unable to inflict even a scratch on Shimat's body, he had grown that much stronger in the meantime.
'These demon fellows, I get the odd feeling that they're attacking me much more than Jin Runcandel.'
That was indeed the case.
Jin also realized that the demons were more favorable towards him than Shimat.
'Could it be because I killed Zito?'
In his curiosity, Sribee winked at Jin.
"You may not know, but you and I are kindred spirits. When the abyss opened in the demon realm, I saw you. So kill this guy called Shimat, and then I'll kill you."
"I don't know whether to be thankful or dumbfounded."
"You should be thankful! Nothing bad will happen to you! But the other two guys are seeing you for the first time, so they'll do as they please."
As he said, the remaining two demons were randomly attacking Jin and Shimat.
The demons were facing a type of enemy they had never encountered before. They were as annoying as mosquitoes, yet impossible to kill or block.

Dodging the blue lightning, aura, magic, and red lightning that were raining down everywhere, the spear warriors were frantically moving around, while the demons were laughing and boldly jumping between the explosions.

Even more, they had the ability to float. Even if the ground collapsed and a hole appeared, they wouldn't fall in. They were constantly finding openings in the spear warriors' defenses and annoying them.
"You know what, Shimat? No matter how strong you are, you're not infinite. Like a dripping droplet eventually pierces a rock, I will pierce through you. Like this, like this!"
Thump! Thump! Sribee's fists consecutively smacked Shimat on the back of his head. He was riding on Shimat's back.
And Shimat couldn't shake him off. He couldn't grab him, and he wouldn't fall if shaken.
Jin was watching Shimat's face being distorted in real-time and thought that he must never be caught like that.
Even as a spear warrior, if someone hangs on your back and keeps punching, your senses are bound to be somewhat dispersed. Jin began to press Shimat even harder.
"......I've seen all sorts of strange sights."
Grit! Shimat gritted his teeth.
He then suddenly began to run madly across the desert, hoping the demons had 'distance limitations.'
"Bakarun! Open a small dimensional gate outside the Mitra Desert at my location."
A moment later, a dimensional gate opened. Shimat went inside, and Jin moved around, avoiding the remaining demons.
He naturally returned to where the original summoning circle was, and Sribee was there. The demons were set to return to their original position if they left the desert.
"Ugh, our weakness was revealed too easily. We can't kill you like this, Jin Run Candle. Are you going to run away now?"
For the demons, if Shimat or Jin left the desert, they couldn't do anything. But the Vamel Alliance and the red demons couldn't abandon or leave the desert.
About 3 minutes later, when Shimat reappeared on the battlefield, Sribee smiled slyly.
"What's this, you shook me off and came back here? That means you have something to do in this desert, right?"
Shimat did not answer. His expressionless face seemed to hide deep anger.
"Whatever it is, you won't succeed. Sribee and my dear friends from the abyss will hinder you until the end, hahaha!"
